items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Well, Cotton Week, Morgan and I, we had McCurdy's on Canal Street.

ctx.x: Cotton Week? Well, Cotton Week, Morgan and I, we had McCurdy's on Canal Street. Well I used to sit on Bill's Cotton. And Gemma Street, Cotton and McCurdy's, you know, four weeks, our people played banjo and Morgan was playing a guitar, you remember Morgan? Which one of them? He used to live on General Tell Street. Morgan used to play guitar. She played guitar and I played banjo.
Well I've heard of Ike and Al and Eddie and Sam and Andrew, but he's not akin to Sam, huh? Who's that?
